content.short: Space Troopers is a high-quality 3D NFT collection on Cardano with passive income and P2E gaming utility.
content.description: Space Troopers is a premium NFT project on the Cardano blockchain featuring 1,000 meticulously rendered 3D characters. Beyond their artistic value, the Troopers offer significant utility, including passive income opportunities for high-rank holders through secondary sale distributions in ADA. The ecosystem features a daily Battle Royale game where players can earn medals and compete for weekly ADA prizes. Developed by Space Trooper Labs, the project also provides one-click staking solutions, bridging the gap between high-end digital art and interactive, reward-based gaming experiences.
